_comment: Sections shown on the PUBLIC toneScan page (templates/page.tonescan-lite.json).
This is an allowlist, not a list of exclusions: a section added to the full
template stays off lite until its key is named here. New work is in progress
until someone says otherwise, and that is the direction a mistake should fall.
Keys are the section keys from templates/page.tonescan.json, and order here is
ignored: lite always follows the full template's order.
Edit with `npm run lite:add <key>` / `npm run lite:remove <key>` rather than by
hand, since both regenerate lite for you. `npm run lite` regenerates on its own.
